description:
Supply chain intelligence APIs for AI agents. Real-time freight rates (85+ carriers), crypto/forex/commodity prices, port congestion (NOAA), shipping
  lanes, economic indicators (FRED), and Cerebrix AI inference. 100 free calls/day, no signup. x402 USDC micropayments, ERC-8004 trust tiers on Polygon.

tools.name: compare_shipping_rates
tools.description: Compare shipping rates across multiple carriers (UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL) for a package. Returns cheapest and fastest options. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_platform_status
tools.description: Check CerebroChain platform health and service availability. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_crypto_prices
tools.description: Get real-time cryptocurrency prices (BTC, ETH, SOL) from CoinGecko. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_forex_rates
tools.description: Get real-time forex exchange rates (EUR/USD, GBP/USD, USD/JPY) from AlphaVantage. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_commodity_prices
tools.description: Get commodity prices (oil, gold, agricultural) from AlphaVantage + World Bank. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_port_congestion
tools.description: Get real-time port congestion data from NOAA water levels for 16 major ports. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_shipping_lanes
tools.description: Get global shipping lane data: 10 major routes, chokepoints, and transit times. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_economic_indicators
tools.description: Get FRED economic indicators: diesel prices, GDP, CPI, unemployment, and more. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: get_freight_rates
tools.description: Get freight shipping rates from Shippo across 85+ carriers. Free — no API key needed.

tools.name: query_inventory
tools.description: Query warehouse inventory levels, movements, and stock alerts. Premium tool. Requires API key (set CEREBROCHAIN_API_KEY env).

tools.name: optimize_route
tools.description: AI-powered route optimization. Calculates optimal delivery route considering traffic, capacity, and time windows. Premium tool. Requires API key.

tools.name: forecast_demand
tools.description: AI-powered demand forecasting. Ask natural language questions about future inventory needs and supply chain patterns. Premium tool. Requires API key.

tools.name: cerebrix_inference
tools.description: Run Cerebrix AI inference for supply chain intelligence. Free — uses bot API free tier.

query.description: Question about supply chain, logistics, or warehouse operations
